claims.summary: Over every field of characteristic3, for every d>=6,d6mod9, the original generic dimension-eight series V_(8,d) is normal with Hasse orders0..128d-321. Its actual saturated elliptic deformation from the defective conic source has exact deformation order1. With D=16d-41, the source order basis gives L_g(R+gQ)=2tR+g(-t²Q_prime+q_(2D-1)t^(2D)), applied to the four fixed character factors. The explicit ninth-power boundary kernel has a nonzero first induced kernel-to-cokernel class. The exact9-condition repair determinant retains C=u^N,X=(u-i)^N+(u+i)^N,Y=i((u-i)^N-(u+i)^N), and has actual leading term u15. Other residues, dimensions and pre-stable thresholds remain open.
claims.assessment: Working uniform theorem passed by one isolated medium reviewer, with no concrete gap or unused hypothesis. The actual saturated frame is derived from the three missing core coefficients, without the inapplicable cut-degree-below-characteristic shortcut. Top core directions are stationary, so first variation remains in the same Laurent ambient. Its full cut vector is amplitude/C times(0,0,0,0,0,0,C,u5,0). The symbolic boundary kernel identity and replacement determinant are exact. At C=0 the determinant is u15*(u²-1)²*((1-u²)X²+u(u²+1)XY-Y²); actual X(0)=2,Y(0)=0 while positive-C terms start at N>=448. Two independent full-source controls verify the frame coefficients, effective first order, kernel reconstruction and every cut entry.
